label: Now Developing
items: The Senate convened as an impeachment court on May 18, summoned VP Sara Duterte, and set the trial proper for July 6 while 23 senators took oath as judges.
The Supreme Court denied Bato dela Rosa’s TRO (9–5–1); the DOJ ordered his arrest on May 21, but he remained at large as the NBI warned more ICC warrants are coming.
ICC Trial Chamber III ordered Rodrigo Duterte to stay detained at The Hague on May 22 as BSP reported a $7.41B BoP deficit for January–April.
